summary: Not published and never to be flipped in this form: the staged private v2026.10 eval file answers its own questions. For each row (island, D) the (island, D+7) feature row ships the label-source price as last_day_mean; a label-blind join reproduces 4,978/4,992 labels with zero mismatches, blind eval AUC 1.0. Secondary defects: 14 eval targets cross the declared 2022-11-01 regime break; VERIFICATION.md claims 58 eval weeks vs 358 actual; train/eval share target week 2016-W01; the threshold rationale cites out-of-window data. The baseline triad itself was verified honest (references and model scale reproduce exactly), so the construction - not the measurement - is what must be rebuilt.
supported_uses: None for v2026.10 as staged; the frozen artifact may serve as a construction post-mortem example only
unsupported_uses: Any publication or benchmark use of the staged v2026.10

cross_row_audit.scope: Pre-flip operator-commissioned audit: label-blind join, holdout never opened, two AUC implementations; 4,978/4,992 labels recovered with zero mismatches

limitations: Exact cross-row label recovery, blind AUC 1.0 (see cross_row_audit scope).
Row selection is outcome-conditioned: shipped rows require the target week's own outcome data to exist in the extract, so eligibility depends on the future.
Strict point-in-time causality is unverified (12 train labels would publish after the first eval prediction under the same D+6 lag; no release-vintage evidence shipped).
required_actions: Rebuild at a common information cutoff or as an as-of interface hiding future covariate rows; purge regime-boundary and shared-week edges; correct the week-count and threshold evidence; re-qualify and re-run the baseline triad; only then re-enter packaging. The staged private v2026.10 must be renamed SUPERSEDED - DO NOT PUBLISH when a corrected version is staged.

evidence.claim: Exact cross-row recovery with proof script

evidence.detail: shipped rows restricted to in-frame weeks whose target values exist
